span.p:
房产交易平台 / 短租酒旅 / 商业写字楼招租
(需处理毛坯空房、杂物二手房与阴天外立面)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 虚拟软装与美化技术路线？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
擅自敲承重墙、扩落地窗、抹平漏水裂缝
违反 MLS 法规且同一客厅 4 个角度沙发全变

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
天空变傍晚但全屋窗户死黑
泳池水面与木地板毫无 2700K 暖光倒影

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 1: M-LSD + SAM-2 锁死墙体/窗框/插座/消防喷淋
硬装结构区 Denoising = 0.0 (99.7% MLS 合规)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 2: LaMa 剥离二手房杂物 + 单应性补全鱼骨木地板
按 2.1m 标准门高标定真实房间米制比例尺

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 3: 统一 3D 房间包围盒投放共享 GLB 家具代理
向 4 个拍摄机位同步投影 Depth/Normal (98.9% 一致)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 4: Day-to-Dusk 蓝调天空 + 2700K 窗户内透与泳池倒影
看房线索 +46.5% · $1.80/套 (省 99.94%)
